arms.fifo: weight-FIFO selection with the OARS observer enabled but behavior-neutral
arms.oars: enacted baseline-budgeted OARS v1 with the identical observer and 1.02 per-decision token ceiling

claim_boundary.allowed_if_all_confirmatory_gates_pass: In the tested Llama-3.2-1B/GSM8K asynchronous training setting, enacted OARS increased retained registered L1 coefficient opportunity while meeting the preregistered systems-utility gates.
forbidden: generalization to other models, workloads, horizons, hardware, or training quality
a training-quality improvement unless the secondary interval independently supports it

confirmatory_design.incomplete_pair_rule: A missing or invalid arm makes that pair incomplete. No replacement, retry, or extension is permitted under this protocol; the primary result is INCONCLUSIVE unless all ten pairs are valid.
confirmatory_design.randomization_method: Python random.Random(20260915).getrandbits(1), generated once before qualification
confirmatory_design.shared_resource_interference_control: Run the two arms of each pair serially in the frozen order; do not overlap confirmatory arms intentionally.

decision_rule.overall: MATERIAL only if all ten pairs are valid, the primary opportunity endpoint passes superiority, and both ordered systems-utility gates pass. Otherwise the registered result is INCONCLUSIVE or NON-MATERIAL according to the primary interval; all estimates and intervals are still reported.
decision_rule.primary_superiority: The two-sided 95% paired-t confidence interval for the OARS-minus-FIFO mean retained-L1 difference must have lower bound above zero; report the exact paired sign-flip randomization p-value as a robustness result.
decision_rule.utility_1_policy_compliance: Every OARS decision selects exactly four unique ready groups, has complete opportunity metadata, has no fallback or skip, and remains at or below 1.02 times that decision's FIFO token budget.
decision_rule.utility_2_wall_time: The two-sided 95% paired-t confidence interval for the mean paired log(OARS/FIFO) time-to-64-updates ratio must have upper bound below log(1.10).
decision_rule.valid_actor_tokens: Report the paired valid-actor-tokens-per-update ratio and 95% interval as the realized training-dose endpoint. It is not relabeled as throughput and is not hidden if lower under OARS.

estimands.primary: mean across matched run pairs of OARS minus FIFO retained registered L1 coefficient opportunity per selected eligible prompt group over updates 1-64
estimands.secondary_final_quality: paired difference in the frozen terminal GSM8K evaluation metric, with a two-sided 95% interval; explicitly not powered as a success gate
systems: paired log ratio of wall time to update 64
paired log ratio of valid actor tokens per update
OARS decision duty and per-decision service-budget compliance

power.basis: A two-sided 95% paired-t interval excluding zero is equivalent to a one-sided 0.025 superiority test.
power.design_sensitivity: With ten complete pairs, a Gaussian paired standardized effect of 1.0 has approximately 0.803 power and an effect of 1.31 has approximately 0.957 power in the frozen 100000-draw simulation.
power.important_limitation: The 14-cell retrospective screen is policy-development evidence, not an actuation effect and not a paired variance estimate; its effect size is used only as a sensitivity reference.

gate: both arms reach exactly 64 updates and exit zero
all expected lifecycle, opportunity, OARS, duty, result, and SHA-256 artifacts authenticate
FIFO actual selections match the recorded FIFO baseline at every observed decision
OARS actual selections match the recorded OARS proposal at every enacted decision
every decision observes exactly eight ready candidates and enumerates 70 four-group combinations
zero missing or invalid opportunity metadata, zero policy fallback, and zero skipped decisions
four unique groups selected per decision and all were ready before mutation
observer/controller duty is at most 1% of controller active time
qualification.interpretation: systems-only; no arm outcomes may be used to modify the confirmatory protocol

qualification_and_confirmatory_separatio: The qualification seed, artifacts, and estimates are never pooled with the ten confirmatory pairs.
stopping_rules: Stop before qualification if local safety, replay, package-authentication, or configuration gates fail.
Stop after qualification if any systems gate fails; diagnose only, with no outcome interpretation and no automatic retry.
After a passing qualification, run exactly the frozen ten confirmatory pairs with no interim outcome inspection.
A platform or code failure does not authorize replacement; any repair requires a separately versioned amendment and explicit user authorization.
